questions.stem: A 28-year-old intravenous drug abuser presents with a history of pain, fever, cough with blood in sputum, night sweats, weight loss, and swelling in his right hip joint. A cold abscess is suspected near the joint upon further examination and investigations. Which of the following is characteristic of this condition?

options.label: A
options.text: Rapid destruction of cartilage by proteolytic enzymes

options.label: B
options.text: Rarely involves the ends of long bones

options.label: C
options.text: Always causes more significant systemic symptoms
